text: This little guy can regrow almost anything.
Lose a leg? It grows back. Even parts of its heart and brain.
It's an axolotl, and it stays a baby its whole life. Gills and all.
In the wild, it lives in just one place: the canals of Mexico City.
And its DNA is about ten times bigger than yours.
Sadly, it's critically endangered. Follow for more wild animals.
